<thought>The carbon‑13 NMR data shows no signals in the typical carbonyl region (≈190–220 ppm for ketones/aldehydes, ≈165–185 ppm for esters/acids). The highest shift is 160.80 ppm, which is more consistent with aromatic or olefinic carbons, not a carbonyl carbon. Therefore the molecule contains no carbonyl (C=O) groups.</thought>
